items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Me and I, I tell you, brought him out on the first job.

ctx.x: T-Boy was good? Yeah, T-Boy. And then, uh, they got some of the young kids up there too, I don't even forget their names, they're pretty good too. Uh, Eddie Gordon, he was, uh, you know, out there. They had an argument. Uh, you know, Lil, uh, I have an iPhone, he was over there too. Me and I, I tell you, brought him out on the first job.
